observations: Both mission plans map distinct outcomes and every A01-A18 to owned executable cards with explicit tests; existing product/source assets are reused and source tests are not misrepresented as executed.

OPO preserves ROI calculation as a bounded candidate and Contract Check optional; useful free release and fulfillment remain independent of payment via conditional OPO-06. Gross follows, impressions, unknown actor types and revenue are distinguished.

WHB explicitly repairs source-grounded bootstrap/account/history/dry-run gaps and keeps all-three-channel gate from blocking X-first release. Source/cultural/scientific review and exact account/public receipts are concrete.
Both final acceptance tasks require two completed real allowed cycles; waiting and synthetic fixtures cannot satisfy runtime acceptance. Direction/restart/uncertain receipt requirements are explicit.
Effect input definitions restrict optional AI reply approvals and R730 migration to those effects; implementer must honor effect-specific applicability, not treat every input as a blanket task gate.
Historical Jira values and source/byte representation limits are preserved. Planning acceptance does not claim runtime, business or provider readiness.
